observations.trace: The diagnostic constructs one source per role, resolves by enum equality, and reports height ranges and complete overlays. The selected main supplies all roles, while the fixed [StageSource;4] signature itself permits duplicates. The private lookup contains a production expect barred by the current crate guide.
observations.remaining: Other callers, representation/alias policy, native geometry and all independent lens coverage remain open; no crash is claimed.

observations.trace: The ordinary producer constructs CompleteSceneContext after complete-context terrain preparation. PreparedTerrainCapture compares self-reported input digest and imported source before reconstructing its surface; its purpose is not checked by that method. The export helper labels metadata complete-context. The separate validate-city-support entrypoint deserializes a capture and invokes the same method without checking purpose; its report says purpose remains in the capture. Inspection TerrainStages separately verifies input/source identity.
observations.remaining: Actual alternate capture producers, whether isolated captures are acceptable to each diagnostic, capture authenticity, output atomicity and report consumers remain open. No false ordinary-producer witness is claimed.

observations.trace: The diagnostic derives its numeric grade from the compiled default. The server can select a validated file and installs that configuration into the resource read by the character motor. The selected motor threshold can therefore differ from the default diagnostic threshold.
observations.remaining: See the conditional finding for the ideal comparison and the explicit disclaimer; no actual scene, YAML, process, controller, movement or diagnostic was run.

conditional_findings.first_contract: The applicable Rust guide prohibits expect outside tests; a source collection should own the stage membership required by its lookup.
conditional_findings.source_witness: The compare-city-terrain diagnostic calls expect on a find by TerrainStageRole. The fixed array is typed as four StageSource entries, but its element type does not enforce one of each role. The same function and guide rule are present at95e.
conditional_findings.counterevidence: The only selected ordinary main construction supplies all four distinct roles, and the authored role-reordering test constructs all four; neither supplies a missing role. The helper is private. No reachable missing-stage panic is asserted and no test ran.
conditional_findings.effect_and_limits: This is a documented repository rule and representation finding, not an observed crash. All callers, exact aliases and independent lenses remain open.
conditional_findings.repair_direction: When separately authorized, represent or handle the four stages explicitly while preserving the role meanings, diagnostic output and comparison scope.
conditional_findings.alias_qualification: Same original059 identifier, recovered and newly checked at95e; not a second historical finding or a checkpoint3821 record.

conditional_findings.first_contract: A diagnostic that presents a controller walkability limit needs its slope threshold associated with the configuration it is describing.
conditional_findings.source_witness: Garden measure_region derives walk_grade from TacticalCombatConfig::default, whose implementation clones compiled-in content/tactical/combat.yaml (40 degrees). Separately the tactical server accepts a combat-config path, validates that YAML, inserts it as a Bevy resource, and apply_character_motor passes its motor to apply_motor_config, which sets the controller minimum walk cosine from the selected maximum slope. Assuming an otherwise valid selected config with 30 degrees and a successful composed-region measurement at grade tan(35 degrees), the default diagnostic predicate compares tan(35) <= tan(40) and reports true, while the selected controller threshold is cos(30), above the ideal face normal cosine cos(35). This is conditional source/monotonicity reasoning only.
conditional_findings.counterevidence: The committed embedded default is 40 degrees and a server using the same authored config shares that threshold. The diagnostic explicitly disclaims traversal and collision-clearance certification; its report can be intentionally a default-config observation. Geometry measurement existence, native controller interpretation, scheduling and actual user output were not exercised.
conditional_findings.effect_and_limits: If readers interpret composed_grade_within_controller_bound as the separately selected tactical server configuration, a non-default server threshold can disagree with that field. The intended diagnostic policy, actual supplied configuration, terrain, report consumer and impact remain open; no traversal or runtime behavior is asserted.
conditional_findings.repair_direction: When separately authorized, bind any controller-specific diagnostic claim to the selected tuning or make the default-only policy and provenance explicit; assess all report consumers and connected geometry constraints.
conditional_findings.alias_qualification: The original059 pending question is preserved and partially assessed; no historical unique count or exact alias is inferred.
